claims.quote: an estimated £151 million boost to the region’s economy
claims.statement: The new GBR headquarters in Derby will bring an estimated £151 million boost to the region's economy.

claims.quote: expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029
claims.statement: Construction of the Becketwell headquarters is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029.

claims.quote: helping to cement the city’s role as Europe’s largest rail hub

claims.quote: Great British Railways will have its home in Derby
claims.statement: Great British Railways will have its home in Derby.

claims.quote: This will bring investment and good jobs, giving young people the chance to build their future in the place they call home.
claims.statement: The Derby headquarters will bring investment and good jobs and give young people the chance to build their future in Derby.

claims.quote: Great British Railways will bring the railway together around one mission - better services for passengers
claims.statement: Great British Railways will bring the railway together around one mission of better services for passengers.

claims.quote: which is creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn
claims.statement: The £2.5 billion youth employment support package is creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn.

claims.quote: bringing hundreds of jobs into the city
claims.statement: Great British Railways being based in Derby will bring hundreds of jobs into the city.

facts.quote: the site of Great British Railways’ (GBR) headquarters is unveiled today (15 October 2026) in Derby
facts.statement: The site of the Great British Railways headquarters in Derby was unveiled.

facts.quote: fares frozen for the first time in 30 years
facts.statement: Fares have been frozen for the first time in 30 years.

facts.quote: 76,000 extra seats a week introduced across the network
